headline: China Rating Agency Downgrades Outlook on France and Philippines to Negative
summary: China Chengxin International Credit Rating revised its sovereign outlook for France and the Philippines to negative from stable, citing slowing economic expansion and fiscal strain.
why: Sovereign rating outlook changes signal mounting fiscal deficit risks and can alter international borrowing costs.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: CCXI lowered France's credit outlook to negative due to fiscal pressures.
